evidence.quote: Core inflation was only 0.7 percent in 2010, compared with around 2-1/2 percent in 2007, the year before the recession began.
it will be several years before the unemployment rate has returned to a more normal level.
the Federal Reserve has indicated that economic conditions are likely to warrant an exceptionally low target rate for an extended period.
And in early November, we announced a plan to purchase an additional $600 billion in longer-term Treasury securities by the middle of this year.
we expect the unemployment rate to remain stubbornly above, and inflation to remain persistently below, the levels that Federal Reserve policymakers have judged to be consistent over the longer term
Until we see a sustained period of stronger job creation, we cannot consider the recovery to be truly established.

parsed.rationale: The speech stresses very low inflation, persistent slack and the need for continued accommodation, defending the asset purchases and the extended-period low-rate guidance. Its discussion of exit tools and of improving growth tempers the dovishness only modestly.
